wet_arc_monthly = {
  every_subject_country = {
    clamp_variable = {
      var = wet_arc_loyalty
      min = -100
      max = 100
    }
  }
  every_other_country = {
    limit = {
      OR = {
        has_country_flag = wet_arc_tribal_signatory
        has_country_flag = wet_arc_waaagh_contact
      }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        has_offensive_war_with = B99
      }
      set_country_flag = wet_arc_oath_broken
      if = {
        limit = {
          has_country_flag = wet_arc_waaagh_contact
        }
        B99 = {
          set_country_flag = wet_arc_waaagh_dispute
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if = {
    limit = {
      G24 = {
        exists = yes
        has_country_leader = {
          character = WET_G24_leader
          ruling_only = yes
        }
        has_country_flag = wet_arc_waaagh_east_agreed
        any_enemy_country = {
          OR = {
            wet_arc_owns_cathay = yes
            wet_arc_owns_mourn = yes
          }
        }
      }
    }
    set_global_flag = wet_story_eastern_waaagh_started
  }
}

      }
      OR = {
        controls_state = 651
        controls_state = 885
        controls_state = 332
        controls_state = 547
        controls_state = 547
        controls_state = 691
        controls_state = 691
      }
      has_country_flag = wet_arc_auric_prepared
      has_global_flag = wet_story_auric_bastion_raised
      NOT = {
        has_global_flag = wet_story_auric_bastion_broken
      }
    }
    clr_country_flag = wet_arc_resolve_auric_focus_pending
    set_global_flag = wet_story_auric_bastion_broken
    army_experience = 15
    set_country_flag = wet_arc_resolve_auric_done
  }
  if = {
    limit = {
      has_country_flag = wet_arc_resolve_great_bastion_focus_pending
      has_completed_focus = WET_ARC_KC02

      wet_arc_infrastructure_credits = 1

  }
